label: レビュー：製造・評価
classification: A review focused on membrane fabrication, surface modification, support/interface design, mechanical or structural characterization, or manufacturing scale-up.
instructions: Relate fabrication choices to resulting structure, defects, measured properties, and scale-up. Distinguish demonstrated results from proposed applications.

sections.heading: 🗾このレビューの要点
sections.instruction: Summarize the main fabrication and evaluation conclusions.

sections.heading: 🛠️製造・改質ルート
sections.instruction: Describe fabrication routes, materials, supports, controllable variables, and resulting structures.

sections.heading: 🔬構造・性能の評価
sections.instruction: Summarize structural, separation, mechanical, thermal, or chemical evaluation methods and conditions.

sections.heading: 🧩欠陥・耐久性・再現性
sections.instruction: Describe defects, interface issues, mechanical/chemical durability, and reproducibility evidence.

sections.heading: 🏗️スケールアップ
sections.instruction: Summarize area, module, continuous-manufacturing, and cost barriers.

sections.heading: 🔍今後の課題
sections.instruction: List author-stated next steps and distinguish them from your inference.
